description: This file implements OAuth2 authentication flow handling for various providers such as GitHub, GitLab, Google, and Microsoft/Azure AD within the TestLink project. It manages provider configuration, session handling, URL generation, and redirects for OAuth2 authorization.

classes.name: Omines\OAuth2\Client\Provider\Gitlab
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for GitLab, used to manage OAuth2 interactions with GitLab.

classes.name: League\OAuth2\Client\Provider\Github
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for GitHub, used for OAuth2 authentication with GitHub.

classes.name: League\OAuth2\Client\Provider\Google
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for Google, used to handle OAuth2 authentication flow with Google.

methods.name: getOAuthProviderCfg
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth provider configuration based on the provider name (e.g., client ID, secret, redirect URI).
